rows.grounds: accusative of time indicating the starting point; form shows final nasal
absolutive expressing action prior to the main verb
correlative particle marking the extent or limit of duration
lunar day designation marking the endpoint of the period
optative expressing prescribed duration or possibility

items.question: What duration of observance is prescribed beginning from one ninth lunar day?
premises: The observance begins from a ninth lunar day.
The prescribed period extends until another ninth lunar day.
The optative verb indicates a prescribed duration.
items.inference: The observance is to be carried out for a period starting on one ninth lunar day and continuing until the next ninth lunar day.
uncertainties: Whether the period spans consecutive lunar fortnights or a full lunar month is not explicitly specified.
items.plain_english: Beginning indeed from the ninth day, it should continue until the ninth day comes again.
